resolved.title: 栈 Stack
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Stack [/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A [b]stack [/b]is a simple data structure that adds and removes elements in a particular order. 
Every time an element is added, it goes on the "top" of the stack. Only an element at the top of the stack can be removed, just like a stack of plates. This behavior is called [b]LIFO [/b](Last In, First Out). [img id="3192" width="80%"]
[s0l0!-header][b]Terminology[/b][/s0l0!-header]
Adding a new element onto the stack is called [b]push[/b].
Removing an element from the stack is called [b]pop[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Applications[/b][/s0l0!-header]
Stacks can be used to create undo-redo functionalities, parsing expressions (infix to postfix/prefix conversion), and much more.
[note]A stack can be implemented using a [b]list[/b] in Python.[/note]

content.text:
**栈**是一个简单的数据结构，它以特定的顺序添加和删除元素。

每增加一个元素，它就会被放在堆栈的 "顶部"。只有在堆栈顶部的元素才能被移除，就像一摞盘子。这种行为被称为 **LIFO**（Last In, First Out，后进先出）。
content.text_html:
A **stack **is a simple data structure that adds and removes elements in a particular order. Every time an element is added, it goes on the "top" of the stack. Only an element at the top of the stack can be removed, just like a stack of plates. This behavior is called **LIFO **(Last In, First Out).

栈是一个简单的数据结构，它以特定的顺序添加和删除元素。 每增加一个元素，它就会被放在堆栈的 "顶部"。只有在堆栈顶部的元素才能被移除，就像一摞盘子。这种行为被称为LIFO **（Last In, First Out）。

content.text:
**术语**

在栈中添加一个新的元素被称**push**(入栈)。

从栈中移除一个元素被称为**pop**（出栈）。

**应用**

栈可以用来创建撤销-重做功能，解析表达式等。
content.text_html:
Terminology Adding a new element onto the stack is called push. Removing an element from the stack is called pop.

Applications Stacks can be used to create undo-redo functionalities, parsing expressions (infix to postfix/prefix conversion), and much more.

应用 堆栈可以用来创建撤销-重做功能，解析表达式（infix到postfix/preix的转换），以及更多。

content.text:
让我们定义并实现**Stack**类及其相应的**push**（入栈）、**pop**（出栈）、**is_empty**（栈空） 和**print_stack**（打印栈） 方法。

我们将使用一个**列表**来存储数据。
content.text_html:
Let's define and implement the Stack class with its corresponding push, pop, **is_empty **and **print_stack **methods.

We will use a list to store the data.

让我们定义并实现Stack类及其相应的push、pop、**is_empty 和print_stack **方法。

我们将使用一个列表来存储数据。

content.text:
正如你所看到的，用一个列表来创建一个栈是很容易的。

我们使用一个列表**items**来存储栈中的元素。
**push**方法在列表的开头添加一个元素，而**pop**方法则删除列表的第一个元素。这样刚好对应栈的特性，后进先出。
content.text_html:
As you can see, it's easy to create a stack using a list. We use a list called items to store our elements. The push method adds an element at the beginning of the list, while the pop method removes the first element of the list.

resolved.title: 浏览器返回
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你需要为浏览器制作一个 **返回** 按钮。

可以使用**栈**(Stack) 来存储访问过的网站链接。每一个新访问的链接都会**push**到栈中。
后退按钮需要从栈中弹出最上面的链接并导航到它。

给定的代码声明了一个**Browser**类作为栈，并实现了一些方法。然后，一些链接被**push**到栈上。之后用一个while循环来返回所有的链接并打印它们。

为**Browser**实现所需的**pop**()方法，使给定的代码按预期工作。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Stack[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a [b]back[/b] button for a browser. 
You use a [b]stack[/b] to store the website links visited. Each new link visited is pushed onto the stack. 
The back button needs to pop the top link from the stack and navigate to it.

The given code declares a [b]Browser[/b] class as a stack and implements some of its methods. Then, some links are pushed onto the stack.
A while loop is then used to go back to all links and print them.

Implement the required [b]pop[/b]() method for the [b]Browser[/b], so that the given code works as expected. 
[note]Note, that the [b]pop[/b]() method needs to return the value, so that it can be printed.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 注意，**pop**()方法需要返回值，以便可以打印。
